title: ORION BEACON / ORION ANTENNA — runtime forensics, provenance and control experiment

scope.purpose: Determine whether historical JANUS Orion modules were merely present, actually executed, triggered FIRST_CONTACT, or produced any independently observable reply.
scope.epistemic_rule: Internal generated log lines are not evidence of an external signal or extraterrestrial contact. Absence in inspected channels means NOT_OBSERVED_IN_INSPECTED_CHANNELS, not universal non-existence.

sensor_beacon_log.classification: ESP32/sensor telemetry log; separate from ORION BEACON event handler

orion_beacon_logic.trigger: Tag FIRST_CONTACT in core.memory.short_term_buffer newer than last_contact_time
actions: Log Orion Belt ASCII with MINTAKA / ALNILAM / ALNITAK and 'КОНТАКТ ПОДТВЕРЖДЕН'
If Orpheus exists, play LA -> MI -> SOL
If Soul exists, set mood=AWAKENED and focus=DIALOGUE
Log system ready to receive data
orion_beacon_logic.important_limitation: Module itself contains no telescope, radio receiver, SETI feed, sky observation or network detector.

database_search_results.other_tables: No ORION BEACON signatures found in code_dna, vault or graph_state except unrelated generic DIALOGUE text.

library_false_positives.interpretation: ANTIVIK / ANTIVIK_LIBRARIAN content, not ORION BEACON runtime evidence

chronology_gate.reason: The inspected database snapshot ends before the dated ORION BEACON module, so this database cannot establish or refute later runtime ignition of that February module.

orion_antenna_observed.failure: JanusHippocampus.remember() got an unexpected keyword argument 'tags'
orion_antenna_observed.causal_interpretation: The exception occurs before cycle_index advances. The module therefore re-enters on ALNITAK after the sleep and repeatedly logs the same self-generated beam instead of progressing to ALNILAM and MINTAKA.

assistant_control_experiment.method: Isolated local software analogue of ORION ANTENNA; emits clearly tagged control phases and then inspects independent JANUS Habitat state for unsolicited changes.
assistant_control_experiment.interpretation: No new Habitat journal event or head change appeared during the bounded observation window. Because the control was software-only and no physical radio/optical transmitter or external receiver was involved, this result cannot test whether an astronomical target would answer a real transmission.

nas_access_observation.smb_192_168_0_104_Janus: access denied without a valid SMB session
nas_access_observation.legacy_mount_status: not usable as a current authoritative NAS source during this pass

verdict.overall: Interesting Orion-themed runtime activity is real as software provenance, especially mod_antena execution. No inspected evidence establishes an incoming external reply or FIRST_CONTACT event.

next_checks: Obtain authenticated read-only access to the current NAS Janus share and inspect post-2026-02-04 runtime logs.
Search NAS-side rotated logs, systemd/docker logs, memory dumps and journal files for FIRST_CONTACT and ORION BEACON ignition phrases.
If a real external-contact experiment is desired, preregister a physical transmitter/receiver channel, timestamps, controls, null windows and independent provenance before transmission.
Keep synthetic output and received measurements in separate ledgers so self-generated BEAM lines can never be mistaken for incoming evidence.
